subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` mitigation after rebase, or wait for a shared work-spawning policy that covers the remaining delegation surfaces?
rationale: The patch changes fallback-turn delegation policy and intentionally leaves related work-spawning surfaces uncovered, so automation cannot choose the product boundary or cross-repo Codex scope.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: After a conflict-free rebase, land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native follow-ups.

options.title: Require Shared Seam First
options.body: Hold the PR until a common policy seam can cover OpenClaw tools and Codex-native delegation consistently.

options.title: Split Follow-Ups First
options.body: Keep the PR paused until maintainers create or assign explicit follow-up ownership for each uncovered surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: After a conflict-free rebase, land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and authored the review that defined the cross-harness scope requirement.
